name: Local Whisper Wake Gate
description: Wake-word gating against a local OpenAI-compatible Whisper endpoint: transcribe an utterance locally, only act when the wake name matches. Ships the canonical gate module plus wake_gate_check / wake_gate_status debug tools.

speachesUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible transcription server base URL (POST <url>/v1/audio/transcriptions). Bridged to OPENCLAW_SPEACHES_URL unless that env is already set — env always wins.

speachesModel.description: Transcription model id (default Systran/faster-distil-whisper-large-v3). Bridged to OPENCLAW_SPEACHES_MODEL.

wakeNames.description: Wake names (comma-separated string or array). Bridged to OPENCLAW_WAKE_NAMES.
